shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | grep -i -E "date|calendar|picker"

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo ---; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "date|dayjs|calendar"; echo ---; grep -o '"version": "[^"]*"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -1; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Popup node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput 2>/dev/null | head -30
timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit=$?"; git status --short; node -v; npm -v
timeout 300 npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit=$?"; grep -A3 '"dependencies"' package.json

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; ls $P/build/esm/components; echo ---; cat $P/build/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; echo ---; cat $P/build/esm/components/DatePicker/DatePicker.d.ts | head -80; echo ---; cat $P/build/esm/index.d.ts; echo ---; cat $P/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|exports)"' ; ls $P/build/esm/components/Calendar | head; grep -rn "dateTimeParse\|export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts | head -20

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; ls $P/dist/esm/components; echo ---CAL; cat $P/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; echo ---DP; cat $P/dist/esm/components/DatePicker/DatePicker.d.ts; echo ---IDX; cat $P/dist/esm/index.d.ts; echo ---CSS; ls $P/dist/esm/components/Calendar/ $P/dist/esm/components/DatePicker/; grep -rn "css" $P/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.js | head -5; echo ---DEMO; ls $P/dist/esm/components/Calendar/__stories__ 2>/dev/null | head

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; cat $P/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts; echo ---; cat $P/dist/esm/components/DatePicker/hooks/datePickerStateFactory.d.ts | head -70; echo ---; cat $P/dist/esm/components/types/inputProps.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls $P/dist/esm/components/types; echo ---; cat $P/dist/esm/components/types/index.d.ts; echo ---LOCALE; ls $P/dist/esm/components/DatePicker/i18n; grep -rn "settings\|locale" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/settings/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; cat $P/dist/esm/components/types/datePicker.d.ts; echo ---INPUTS; cat $P/dist/esm/components/types/inputs.d.ts; echo ---HELPERS; cat $P/dist/esm/components/types/helpers.d.ts; echo ---CALTYPES; sed -n 1,80p $P/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts; echo ---README; sed -n 1,80p $P/README.md

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; sed -n 1,80p $U/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | grep -n -i "lang\|configure" ; echo ---; cat $U/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null || grep -rln "export.*configure" $U/components/utils/*.d.ts; echo ---; grep -rn "useLang\|getConfig\|subscribeConfigure" $U/hooks/useLang/*.js $U/components/theme/useThemeContext.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "i18n\|useLang\|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/utils.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rln "useLang\|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/*.js | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/components/theme/useLang.d.ts; echo ---; cat $U/components/theme/useLang.js | head -30; echo ---DC; grep -n "useLang\|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/CalendarView.js | head; echo ---TP; grep -n "lang" $U/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo ---CFG; grep -rn "configure" $U/components/index.d.ts $U/index.d.ts | head -3; cat $U/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40

sed -i 's|<Text variant="subheader-2" as="label" {...{ htmlFor: '"'"'date-picker'"'"' }}>|<Text variant="subheader-2" as="label" htmlFor="date-picker">|' src/App.tsx && grep -n 'as="label"' src/App.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit=$?"
timeout 240 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "build exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -2; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1; node -e "require.resolve('puppeteer')" 2>&1 | head -1) ; echo ---; cat .gitignore; git status --short

ls node_modules | grep -E "^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$"; ls node_modules/@testing-library 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; rm -rf dist && printf 'dist/\n' >> .gitignore && cat .gitignore && git status --short
timeout 240 npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund jsdom 2>&1 | tail -3; git status --short; ls node_modules | grep -c jsdom

sed -n 520,540p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/src/components/DateField/utils.ts; echo ---; grep -n "localeData\|getLocaleData" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/dateTime/dateTime.js | head -5; grep -n "function localeData\|localeData" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/dateTime/*.js | head -5; echo ---; grep -n "setLocale\|loadLocale\|getLocale" -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/settings/settings.js | head -60

sed -i 's|expect((input as HTMLInputElement).value).toMatch(/^15\\.\\d\\d\\.2026$/);|expect((input as HTMLInputElement).value.replace(/[\\u2066-\\u2069]/g, "")).toBe("15.11.2026");|' src/__verify__.test.tsx && grep -n 'toBe("15.11.2026")' src/__verify__.test.tsx && timeout 240 npx vitest run --config vitest.verify.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "✓|×|Tests|passed|failed" && echo "=== cleanup ===" && rm -f src/__verify__.test.tsx vitest.verify.config.ts && timeout 200 npm uninstall --no-save --no-audit --no-fund jsdom 2>&1 | grep -v allow-scripts | tail -2; ls node_modules | grep -c '^jsdom$'; echo "=== final build ===" && timeout 240 npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "built in|error" ; rm -rf dist; echo "=== git ==="; git status --short; git diff -- package.json .gitignore
